steps: Reset and granted MobileSafari location permission with simctl privacy.
Set simulator coordinates with xcodebuildmcp simulator-management set-location.
Filled name and valid CPF in Safari and entered the table home screen.

notes: Coordinate tapping on the home SoftInput submit button did not trigger navigation, so the assistant prefill URL was opened directly in the same Safari session.
The LM Studio call completed and persisted assistant_messages with provider/model metadata.
The final Safari screenshot after direct prefill showed the QR-required fallback, so visual chat-bubble rendering on iOS Safari was not claimed in this run.
